_comment: Cards that exist only for the player-only attack prohibition test (tests/unit/combat/test_cant_attack_you_player_only.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_ramonda_wall` is Queen Mother Ramonda's second line exactly as printed: a `cant_attack_you` static with `player_only`, a current-power ceiling and the monarch condition. `t_ramonda_walkers` is the near miss -- the same line without `player_only`, which also walls off its controller's planeswalkers and battles -- and is asserted against as the counterfactual.

cards.name: Test Queen Mother
cards.oracle_text: As long as you're the monarch, creatures with power 2 or less can't attack you.
